name: smwmusic-super-mario-advance-jar
title: Super Mario Advance - Jar
description:
A small bonus theme exclusive to Super Mario Advance version of Super Mario Bros. 2, A game I used to play a lot as a kid and always loved this small tune.
Would probably fit as a bonus area theme.

I noticed SMA uses a lot of samples from SMW / All-Stars so it would be relatively simple to port its music to SMW.
